name: Jesus Wept
overview: The brief yet profound statement "Jesus wept" reveals the deep compassion and sorrow of Christ as He responded to human grief, particularly in the context of Lazarus's death (John 11:1, 33, 35). This moment reflects His identification with our sorrows, fulfilling the prophecy of Isaiah that He is a man acquainted with grief (Isaiah 53:3). His weeping also underscores His loving concern for the lost, as seen when He wept over Jerusalem (Luke 19:41), demonstrating the heart of God who gave His Son to grant eternal life to believers (John 3:16).
